scope: Studio desktop Play Solo on the saved Review01, full residency, graphics quality Automatic, FOV 70, camera at each home spawn (eye height +6) looking at the mountain (4096,240,-820) through the gate. 120 RenderStepped frames per view. Focus verified by a 1 s foreground-window log; a first run (all ~66.7 ms = 15 FPS unfocused throttle) and homes 7-8 of the second run were discarded and re-sampled.
notes: Triangle counts vary with Automatic quality ramping after focus changes (homes 7-8 sampled right after a refocus), so they are not a like-for-like comparison with Review02's 668k-722k. Desktop GPU only; not a device measurement.
